name: Inverse Projection for Single-View Reconstruction
definition: A technique to perform single-view reconstruction by optimizing the periodic activation parameters (frequencies and phase shifts) of a frozen implicit radiance field generator to match a target image, without modifying the network weights.
summary: Inverse Projection optimizes periodic activation parameters of a frozen implicit radiance field generator to reconstruct 3D scenes from single images, distinguishing itself by treating sinusoidal embeddings as optimization variables rather than modifying network weights.
